output.summary: Perennial thistle native to western and central Mediterranean regions, with a native presence in Portugal. It has violet-purple flower heads with fleshy receptacles and green-purple bracts ending in spines; its natural milk-coagulating effect is used in cheesemaking.
output.edibilityNote: Its natural milk-coagulating effect is used to make cheeses such as Serra da Estrela and Nisa.
